summary: Client a at LTP, client b at Quote on the same instrument: the feed type follows the highest mode; one full packet serves both; when b leaves the feed goes back to LTP.

notes: The feed type follows the highest mode held: LTP to ALL and back are each one subscribe at the new type, with no unSubscribe, as the web's adapter moves a held scrip (subscribe_scrips at max(modes); test_hdfcsky_quote_feed.py::test_modes_tracked_and_highest_kept_at_broker).

deviations.reason: Back at the LTP type, the LTP packet carries no close (proto3 0). The web publishes close and prev_close 0.0 from it and so no change; the desktop keeps the close the same connection's full packet carried (the bridge keeps each field's last known value, feed/bridge/snapshot.rs) and the change from it. Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are a web defect.

HDFC Securities sends lastTradeTime in epoch seconds (the web's own test pairs lastTradeTime 1700000000 with packetTimestamp 1700000000000); the web sends it unconverted as ltt, a docs key that is epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop converts it to ms (investright::trade_time_ms). Lead decision: ltt in seconds -> ms, web defect (wrong unit).

A cash equity's packet carries no OI (proto3 writes oi 0); the web sends that 0 as oi and open_interest instead of leaving them out (web openalgo#2376). The desktop counts OI on the derivative segments only. Lead decision: web zeros for values the stream did not send are left out, web defect.
